name: 3one4 Capital
tagline: Transformative capital for the new Indian economy
description: Bengaluru-based early-stage firm founded by Pranav and Siddarth Pai, backing seed and Series A startups across fintech, SaaS/enterprise, consumer, health, media and deep tech. Backer of Licious, Darwinbox and Jupiter.

name: Accel India
tagline: Backing exceptional teams from inception onward
description: The India practice of global VC firm Accel, investing from seed through growth across SaaS, consumer internet, fintech, marketplaces and deep tech. Early investor in Flipkart, Freshworks, Swiggy and BrowserStack.

name: Alpha Wave Global
tagline: Global growth equity investor
description: Growth-equity investment firm with offices across Miami, New York, London, Abu Dhabi, Bangalore, Mumbai and New Delhi. Its India arm operates as Alpha Wave India from Indiranagar.

name: Anicut Capital
tagline: Private credit and equity for Indian entrepreneurs
description: A multi-asset investment manager running private credit (venture debt / growth finance) and equity funds, including the Grand Anicut private credit funds plus seed, growth and late-stage equity strategies.

name: Ankur Capital
tagline: Deep-tech and science-based early-stage venture capital
description: An early-stage VC backing deep-tech and science-led startups in agritech, healthcare, climate, food and enabling technologies aimed at India's next billion consumers and producers.

name: Antler India
tagline: Day-zero investing in obsessed outlier founders
description: India arm of the global day-zero VC Antler, investing at the pre-seed / pre-product stage with an AI-first focus alongside SaaS, deep tech, consumer tech and fintech. 115+ India portfolio companies.

name: Arali Ventures
tagline: Pre-seed and seed VC for enterprise-tech founders
description: A Bengaluru-based pre-seed/seed fund (est. 2018) backing B2B and enterprise-technology startups across SaaS, deeptech, fintech, agritech and climate tech.

name: Arkam Ventures
tagline: Early-stage venture capital built for 'Middle India'
description: Bengaluru-based early-stage firm investing in founders building for 'Middle India' across fintech, consumer, enterprise AI, deeptech and manufacturing.

name: Athera Venture Partners
tagline: Early-stage Indian venture firm backing tech founders
description: Formerly Inventus Capital India, Athera is a Bengaluru-based early-stage venture firm investing in technology-focused startups across SaaS, deeptech, consumer and mobility.

name: Avataar Venture Partners
tagline: Growth-stage operational VC for B2B and SaaS companies
description: Bengaluru-headquartered growth-stage 'operational VC' backing B2B and SaaS founders scaling into global businesses, with an emphasis on AI-enabled platforms across vertical software and enterprise tech.

name: Axilor Ventures
tagline: Early-stage fund and accelerator for Indian startups
description: Co-founded by Infosys co-founders Kris Gopalakrishnan and S. D. Shibulal, Axilor is a Bengaluru early-stage investor and accelerator backing seed and pre-Series A startups across enterprise tech, deep tech, healthcare and climate.

name: Bessemer Venture Partners India
tagline: Global venture firm with a Bengaluru-based India practice
description: The India arm of Bessemer Venture Partners, operating from Bengaluru for nearly two decades, investing across consumer internet, SaaS, fintech and vertical software.

name: Beyond Next Ventures
tagline: Long-term investor in deep-tech and deep-science ventures
description: Japan-founded venture firm whose India arm is Bengaluru-based, backing pre-seed to Series A deep-tech and deep-science startups from lab stage onward.

name: Blume Ventures
tagline: India's leading early-stage, founder-first venture fund
description: Early-stage (seed and pre-Series A) India-focused fund founded in 2011, backing tech founders across SaaS, fintech, consumer internet, deep/emerging tech and EVs. Portfolio includes Unacademy, Purplle, Slice and Exotel.

name: Cactus Venture Partners
tagline: Operator-led early-growth investor for resilient founders
description: An operator-led, early-growth-stage (primarily Series A) India venture fund backing founders with product-market fit and recurring revenue. Launched 2020.

name: Campus Fund
tagline: India's student-led venture fund
description: India's first student-led venture fund, investing at pre-seed / seed in startups founded by current students, recent graduates and dropouts across deep tech, space tech and climate.

name: Capria Ventures
tagline: Global South venture capital with an Applied AI focus
description: A Global South specialist VC investing early- and growth-stage capital in tech startups (increasingly Applied AI) across India, Latin America, Africa and Southeast Asia. Unitus Ventures merged into Capria in 2023; Bengaluru is its primary India office.

name: Catamaran Ventures
tagline: N. R. Narayana Murthy's family office backing Indian founders
description: The Bengaluru-based family office of Infosys co-founder N. R. Narayana Murthy, making venture, growth and public-market investments across India and running joint ventures with global partners.

name: Chiratae Ventures
tagline: Backing Indian tech entrepreneurs, early to growth stage
description: Formerly IDG Ventures India, Chiratae is one of India's largest technology-focused venture firms, backing early- and growth-stage startups across consumer tech, SaaS, fintech, health-tech and deep tech.

name: Dexter Ventures
tagline: Collaboration beyond capital for pre-seed and seed founders
description: A Bengaluru micro-VC (DeVC, grown from the Dexter Angels syndicate) backing pre-seed and seed startups across fintech infra, horizontal SaaS, AI-first, consumer brands, healthtech and B2B commerce.

name: Eight Roads Ventures India
tagline: Fidelity-backed growth investor in Indian tech companies
description: The India team of Eight Roads, the global proprietary investment arm backed by Fidelity, backing growth-stage technology, healthcare and financial-services companies from its Bengaluru office.

name: Elevar Equity
tagline: Early growth capital for entrepreneurial households
description: An impact-focused equity investor providing early-growth capital to businesses serving low-income, underserved communities across financial services, healthcare, agriculture and education.

name: Elevation Capital
tagline: Built for the audacious — seed and early-stage India investor
description: Formerly SAIF Partners, Elevation Capital is one of India's oldest venture firms, providing seed and early-stage capital across consumer tech, consumer brands, fintech, enterprise AI, frontier tech and healthcare.

name: Exfinity Ventures
tagline: Investors in early-stage B2B technology ventures
description: A Bengaluru-based VC (founded 2014) investing in early-stage B2B technology startups across SaaS, deeptech, enterprise tech, EVs and fintech.

name: Fireside Ventures
tagline: Early-stage fund backing India's consumer brands
description: Bengaluru-headquartered early-stage fund (est. 2017) focused on consumer brands across food & beverage, personal care, beauty and lifestyle. Early backer of boAt, Mamaearth and The Sleep Company.

name: Flipkart Ventures
tagline: Flipkart's fund and accelerator for early-stage startups
description: Flipkart's $100M venture fund and 'Leap Ahead' accelerator, run from its Bengaluru HQ, backing seed-to-Series A technology startups across e-commerce, deep tech, AI and consumer/enterprise sectors.

name: General Catalyst India
tagline: Early- and growth-stage investing in India (formerly Venture Highway)
description: Venture Highway, a Bengaluru early-stage VC (backer of Meesho, ShareChat, Moglix), merged into General Catalyst in 2024 to form General Catalyst India, deploying growth and early-stage capital across consumer, fintech, SaaS and AI.

name: Gruhas
tagline: Nikhil Kamath & Abhijeet Pai's early-stage venture firm
description: A Bengaluru-based investment firm co-founded by Nikhil Kamath (Zerodha) and Abhijeet Pai, investing in early- and growth-stage startups across proptech, cleantech/climate, media & entertainment and consumer.

name: Ideaspring Capital
tagline: Fuelling deep-tech enterprise entrepreneurship from India
description: An early-stage VC investing in science and deep-tech startups building global B2B enterprise products from India, across AI, climate tech, defence, biotech and enterprise software.

name: Incubate Fund Asia
tagline: Founder-first pre-seed and seed venture firm
description: Japan-origin seed-focused venture firm (formerly Incubate Fund India) with a Bengaluru office, investing at pre-seed and seed stage across India and Southeast Asia, sector-agnostic with a growing deep-tech lean.

name: India Quotient
tagline: Early-stage investor backing original Indian founders
description: Bengaluru-based early-stage venture firm (est. 2011) investing at seed and Series A across consumer, fintech, SaaS and AI, backing original entrepreneurs building for India-first markets. Early backer of Sharechat and Sugar Cosmetics.

name: Infosys Innovation Fund
tagline: Infosys corporate fund backing enterprise-tech startups
description: The venture investment arm of Infosys, run from its Bengaluru HQ, investing in startups aligned with Infosys's strategic priorities across AI/ML, IoT, SaaS and deep tech.

name: Iron Pillar
tagline: Growth capital for Indian technology companies
description: A venture-growth fund providing scale-up capital to mid-to-late-stage Indian technology companies going global, across SaaS, enterprise tech, consumer internet and fintech.

name: Java Capital
tagline: India's deep-tech seed fund
description: A Bengaluru-based SEBI-registered seed/pre-seed VC (founded 2020) investing across deeptech and climate tech, working with founders from MVP/idea stage to product-market fit.

name: Kalaari Capital
tagline: Early-stage tech investor partnering visionary founders
description: Bengaluru-based early-stage venture firm founded in 2006, investing primarily at seed and Series A in tech-driven Indian companies across consumer, SaaS, fintech, healthtech and deep tech. Early backer of Dream11, Myntra and Cure.fit.

name: LetsVenture
tagline: India's leading platform for early-stage startup investing
description: A Bengaluru-based platform (now LVX Ventures) connecting startup founders with angel investors and family offices, running investor syndicates across seed and pre-Series A private markets.

name: Lighthouse Canton
tagline: Global asset manager with an India venture debt fund
description: A Singapore-headquartered global investment institution offering wealth and asset management, running India private-market strategies including the LC Venture Debt Fund providing venture debt and growth capital to startups.

name: Lightspeed India Partners
tagline: Early-stage tech investor backing bold Indian founders
description: The India arm of Lightspeed Venture Partners, investing at early and growth stage across consumer, enterprise/SaaS, fintech, AI and climate. Early backer of Udaan, OYO and Sharechat.

name: Mela Ventures
tagline: Early-stage VC for deeptech, AI and enterprise tech
description: A Bengaluru-based early-stage fund founded by Mindtree co-founders KK Natarajan and Parthasarathy NS, investing in B2B startups across enterprise technology, deeptech and climate tech.

name: Menterra Venture Advisors
tagline: Impact investing in healthcare, education and climate
description: A Bengaluru-based impact venture capital firm backing early-stage, scalable ventures solving problems in healthcare, education, agriculture, climate and livelihoods for underserved Indian populations.
address: Craig Park Layout, off MG Road

name: Micelio Fund
tagline: India's clean-mobility and EV venture fund
description: A Bengaluru-based fund backing early-stage startups building electric vehicles, EV sub-systems and clean-mobility technologies.

name: Multiply Ventures
tagline: Thesis-driven early-stage VC for India's consumer opportunity
description: Bengaluru-based, thesis-driven early-stage VC (est. 2020) investing in consumer, consumer-tech and fintech startups, run by ex-Myntra/Flipkart/Paytm operators.

name: Nadathur Holdings & Investments
tagline: Family office of Infosys co-founder N. S. Raghavan
description: The Bengaluru-based family office of Infosys co-founder N. S. Raghavan, investing across venture capital, private equity, public securities and real estate, with thematic bets in science and technology.

name: Neon Fund
tagline: First-cheque investor in enterprise-AI and B2B SaaS
description: An early-stage (pre-seed to seed) fund backing Indian founders building global B2B SaaS and AI-native enterprise software, with heavy GTM and hiring support.

name: Nexus Venture Partners
tagline: Backing product-first founders from seed onward
description: Early- and growth-stage firm investing in product-first companies across India and the US, spanning enterprise/SaaS, AI, consumer internet, fintech and developer tools. Backer of Postman, Druva and Delhivery.

name: Northern Arc Capital
tagline: Diversified credit platform for underserved businesses
description: An RBI-registered NBFC and diversified debt platform channelling financing to under-served retail and MSME segments across India via lending, co-lending, guarantees and AIF debt funds.

name: Omnivore
tagline: Investing in agriculture, food and climate startups
description: An impact VC that pioneered agritech investing in India, funding entrepreneurs building the future of agriculture, food systems and climate in India and Southeast Asia.

name: Peak XV Partners
tagline: More than capital — deep partnerships across stages
description: Formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA, rebranded as the independent firm Peak XV Partners in 2023. Invests from seed to growth across India and Southeast Asia; portfolio includes Razorpay, CRED, Zomato and Meesho.

name: pi Ventures
tagline: Early-stage deep tech and AI venture fund
description: Bengaluru-based early-stage firm (est. 2016) investing in deep technology and AI startups spanning AI, spacetech, biotech, quantum computing and materials science.

name: PointOne Capital
tagline: First-cheque micro-VC for pre-seed deep-tech founders
description: A Bengaluru-based micro-VC writing first-equity cheques into pre-seed and seed tech-led and deep-tech startups. Sector-agnostic; has backed 70+ companies since 2021.

name: Premji Invest
tagline: Long-term capital investing Azim Premji's wealth across stages
description: The Bengaluru-based investment office managing Wipro founder Azim Premji's personal and philanthropic wealth, investing across private equity, growth, venture and public markets in India and globally.

name: Prime Venture Partners
tagline: Early-stage, founders-first, sector-agnostic venture capital
description: Early-stage (seed/Series A) firm run by former operators, backing tech-driven founders across fintech, SaaS and healthcare, investing in only a handful of companies per year. Early backer of MoEngage, Niyo and Quizizz.

name: Qualcomm Ventures
tagline: Corporate VC backing deep-tech and connectivity startups
description: Qualcomm's global corporate venture arm, investing in early- and growth-stage companies across AI, semiconductors, connectivity, mobility and enterprise. Its India practice runs from Bengaluru.

name: Rainmatter Capital
tagline: Zerodha's fund backing fintech, climate and health ventures
description: The investment and incubation arm of stockbroker Zerodha, based at Zerodha's Bengaluru HQ, backing early-stage startups in fintech, climate and health with long-term, founder-friendly capital.

name: Rebright Partners
tagline: Asia-focused early-stage venture capital
description: A Japan/Singapore-based early-stage VC with a Bengaluru office for India deals, investing in tech startups across India and Southeast Asia in fintech, deeptech and SaaS.

name: RTP Global
tagline: Early-stage global VC
description: Early-stage venture firm investing in technology companies globally, with a Bengaluru office in HSR Layout Sector 1 alongside its London, New York and Dubai bases.

name: Saama Capital
tagline: Early-stage India venture capital across consumer and tech
description: An early-stage venture firm investing in Indian consumer, fintech, SaaS and technology startups, with a Bengaluru office and a US presence in Palo Alto.

name: Seafund
tagline: Deep-tech and deep-science pre-seed to pre-Series A VC
description: A Bengaluru-based early-stage venture fund backing deeptech and deep-science startups in semiconductors, AI/ML, cybersecurity, space, robotics, medtech and EV.

name: Silverneedle Ventures
tagline: Conviction-first VC backing early-stage Indian tech founders
description: An early-stage (pre-Series A / Series A) tech fund (founded 2022) investing across B2B SaaS, deeptech, sustainability, D2C and consumer internet.

name: Sparrow Capital
tagline: Patient, disciplined capital for 0-to-1 founders
description: A Bengaluru-based early-stage / micro-VC (est. 2020) aiming to be the first institutional partner to founders at the '0 to 1' stage, sector-agnostic with a lean toward SaaS, B2B and fintech.

name: Speciale Invest
tagline: The deeptech VC — science and engineering-first
description: A seed and early-stage deeptech VC (founded 2017) backing hardware and software founders solving large problems in space, energy, climate, AI, robotics, semiconductors and life sciences.

name: Stellaris Venture Partners
tagline: From ideas to infinity — backing early-stage founders
description: Bengaluru-based early-stage firm founded by ex-Helion partners, investing from idea stage through Series A across AI, software/SaaS, consumer tech, fintech, brands and sustainability.

name: Stride Ventures
tagline: Venture debt for growth-stage startups
description: A leading venture debt / credit fund (founded 2018) providing debt financing to institutionally-backed, growth-stage startups across India, the GCC and Southeast Asia. Backer of Zepto, Bira and Spinny.

name: TDV Partners
tagline: Pre-seed consumer VC fund
description: TDV Partners is a pre-seed venture fund backing consumer startups in India. Sits in Campus 3B of RMZ Ecoworld, Bellandur — the same building as Elevation Capital (location shared by the fund).

name: Together Fund
tagline: Operator-led early-stage fund for AI and SaaS companies
description: Operator-led, AI-first early-stage venture firm founded by former SaaS founders (incl. Freshworks' Girish Mathrubootham), backing AI-native and SaaS startups across the US–India corridor.

name: Transition VC
tagline: India's first energy-transition venture fund
description: A Bengaluru-based venture fund investing in early-stage startups across clean energy, energy transition, decarbonization and climate technology.

name: Trifecta Capital
tagline: Venture debt and growth financing for Indian startups
description: One of India's leading venture financing platforms, offering venture debt, growth equity and financial advisory to startups across their lifecycle. Founded 2015.

name: Turbostart
tagline: Accelerator plus early-stage seed / pre-Series A fund
description: A Bengaluru-based early-stage VC fund and global accelerator combining incubator, accelerator, venture-studio and fund models across B2B tech, SaaS, fintech, consumer tech, AI/ML and deeptech.

name: Upekkha
tagline: AI accelerator and fund for global Indian SaaS founders
description: A Bengaluru-based SaaS-focused accelerator and fund (est. 2017) backing early-stage B2B, enterprise software and vertical-AI startups led by Indian founders building for global markets.

name: Ventureast
tagline: One of India's longest-standing VCs, investing since 1997
description: A veteran Indian VC (investing since 1997) backing early- and growth-stage technology, healthcare / life-sciences, deeptech and financial-inclusion companies through its multiple funds.

name: WaterBridge Ventures
tagline: Early-stage VC backing India's boldest founders
description: An early-stage (seed / pre-Series A) India-focused venture firm that often writes the first institutional cheque, operating from New Delhi and Bengaluru.

name: WestBridge Capital
tagline: India-focused growth and public-market investor
description: An India-focused investment firm (rooted in the original WestBridge/Sequoia India team) investing large, long-duration capital in growth-stage private companies and Indian listed equities.

name: Yali Capital
tagline: Deep-tech VC backing India's semiconductor and hard-tech founders
description: A Bengaluru-based SEBI-registered deep-tech VC investing in fabless semiconductors, AI, robotics, smart manufacturing, aerospace and life sciences. Closed its first fund at ₹893 crore in 2025.

name: Z47
tagline: Founders-first early-stage firm, formerly Matrix Partners India
description: Z47 (rebranded from Matrix Partners India in 2024, est. 2006) is an early-stage venture firm investing in Indian tech startups across consumer, fintech, SaaS and enterprise. Portfolio includes Ola, Razorpay and Dealshare.
